subject.title: fix(agents): safely guard optional binding.sessionId in setCliSessionBinding

question: For a CLI-backed session whose OpenClaw mirror lacks the authoritative conversation, should direct RPC compaction explicitly report that there is nothing OpenClaw can summarize, or should it route to the CLI transcript compaction mechanism?
rationale: The PR chooses a silent no-op at a binding helper, but the linked report shows that the real user-visible contract concerns compaction and preservation of session history rather than only dereferencing an optional value.

options.title: Define a safe no-summary result
options.body: Return an explicit, non-destructive result for direct RPC compaction when the mirrored session lacks content, preserving current transcript and token state.

options.title: Route RPC compaction to CLI transcript handling
options.body: Make the direct RPC path compact the authoritative CLI transcript when that integration can provide equivalent safety and accounting.

recommendation.title: Define a safe no-summary result
recommendation.body: Return an explicit, non-destructive result for direct RPC compaction when the mirrored session lacks content, preserving current transcript and token state.
